summary: Market sentiment on Sunday, July 12, 2026, is cautiously bullish for major crypto assets with analysts emphasizing support levels around $86,000 for Bitcoin and strength in Ethereum to drive altcoins. Swing traders are focusing on liquidity and clean technical structures in SOL and AVAX, while macro views suggest waiting for lower entry points in certain equities like Nvidia before confirming a rally.
